hook.name: UniswapV4Hook
hook.description: A burn-and-buyback hook that charges a 2.2% fee on buys (ETH routed to a reserve for periodic buybacks) and burns 2.2% of tokens on sells. Liquidity additions are restricted to one initial deposit. Contains a hidden allowlist mechanism in afterSwap that can selectively block sells from non-allowlisted addresses when activated by any caller via superposition() (allowlist membership itself is controlled by the deployer).
